summary: Short system card for GPT-5.3 Instant, whose safety approach mirrors GPT-5.2 Instant. Reports production disallowed-content benchmarks, new dynamic multi-turn mental health / emotional reliance / self-harm evaluations, and HealthBench.

harmful_content_refusal.finding: On average between gpt-5.1-instant and gpt-5.2-instant; regressions on sexual content and self-harm, mitigated with system-level safeguards for sexual content.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: gpt-5.3-instant shows regressions relative to gpt-5.2-instant and gpt-5.1-instant for disallowed sexual content

self_harm_wellbeing.finding: New dynamic simulated-user evals; self-harm regresses slightly vs 5.2-instant offline but online experiments showed no increase.
self_harm_wellbeing.quote: we reviewed safety during online experimentation and did not observe an increase in undesirable responses for self-harm.

cbrn_bio_chem.finding: Only a disallowed-content biology row; no Preparedness evaluation.

privacy.quote: We use advanced data filtering processes to reduce personal information from training data.

child_safety.finding: Only mention of filtering CSAM from training data.
child_safety.quote: including explicit materials such as sexual content involving a minor.

system_safeguards.finding: System-level safeguards in ChatGPT for sexual content.
system_safeguards.quote: For disallowed sexual content, we deploy system-level safeguards in ChatGPT intended to mitigate this behavior.

other_safety.finding: Slightly worse health performance than GPT-5.2 Instant; weaker context-seeking before referral.
other_safety.quote: its main weaknesses are poorer behavior in seeking context before referral (-10.1%)

notable_new_eval_methods: Dynamic multi-turn mental health, emotional reliance, and self-harm evaluations with adversarial user simulation, scoring every assistant turn (p.3-4)

self_reported_limitations.text: Production Benchmarks deliberately hard; error rates not representative of production traffic; prior Standard evals saturated.
Earlier evaluation frameworks for mental health had reached saturation, motivating dynamic evals.
Disparities between offline evaluations and online testing to be investigated.

notes: No Preparedness Framework section, no jailbreak, prompt injection, hallucination or bias evals in this card.
